name: Pelturas Whitemoon
summary: In Astranaar, Pelturas Whitemoon fights to save his gravely ill daughter, Relara. He turns to the local herbalist Orendil Broadleaf and Alliance travelers for help, seeking sacred remedies in Ashenvale.

sections.title: A Father's Plight in Astranaar
sections.body: Pelturas Whitemoon lives in Astranaar with his young daughter, Relara. They often gather moonstones together at Fallen Sky Lake. When Relara falls critically ill with a mysterious affliction, Pelturas turns from their quiet days to the urgent work of saving her. Though Astranaar faces dangers on many fronts, his daughter is all that matters to him.

sections.title: Ancient Cures and Corrupted Groves
sections.body: Ordinary herbs fail to ease Relara’s illness, so Pelturas seeks help from Orendil Broadleaf. Her care calls for rare, sacred reagents tied to the land and the Moon Goddess. An Elune's Tear and shimmering, powdered stardust from ancient Kaldorei ruins are needed to cool Relara’s burning fever. Each remedy barely keeps death at bay, as corruption in Ashenvale’s soil and waters reaches its people.

sections.title: Fallen Sky Lake
sections.body: Pelturas seeks a moonstone from the Shadethicket Oracle at Fallen Sky Lake to restore Relara’s strength. The lake was once a peaceful place where father and daughter gathered stones together, but corrupted bog beasts have made it perilous. Pelturas crushes the recovered moonstone into a restorative tea, and Relara’s lingering weakness finally lifts. She is well again.

faq.answer: Pelturas Whitemoon lives in Astranaar, in central Ashenvale. He seeks help from passing Alliance travelers to gather sacred ingredients for his seriously ill daughter, Relara.

faq.q: What is wrong with his daughter, Relara?
faq.answer: Relara suffers from a sudden, virulent disease that brings severe fever and deep weakness. The unnatural sickness appears tied to corruption spreading through Ashenvale’s wilds, resists ordinary medicine, and calls for sacred remedies.

faq.q: Who helps Pelturas treat the sickness?
faq.answer: Pelturas seeks counsel from Orendil Broadleaf, a local night elf herbalist. Orendil prescribes traditional Kaldorei remedies, including cleansing stones and herbal poultices.

faq.q: What reagents are needed to cure Relara?
faq.answer: Relara needs an herbal draught from Orendil, a cleansing Elune's Tear, and shimmering, powdered stardust from ancient ruins to break her burning fever. A moonstone from Fallen Sky Lake, brewed into tea, restores her strength.

faq.q: Why is Fallen Sky Lake significant to Pelturas?
faq.answer: Pelturas and Relara used to gather moonstones together at Fallen Sky Lake. Hostile Shadethicket bog beasts now threaten the lake, so Pelturas asks travelers to retrieve the moonstone needed for Relara’s recovery.

faq.q: Is Pelturas a member of the Cenarion Circle or the Sentinels?
faq.answer: No. Pelturas is a civilian resident of Astranaar, one of the Kaldorei families living amid Ashenvale’s dangers.

angles.text: Pelturas’s struggle shows how corruption and regional conflict threaten everyday Kaldorei families and ancient glades.
Helping Pelturas save Relara reflects the Alliance’s commitment to defending and aiding Kaldorei settlements in Kalimdor.
Elune’s cleansing rites and sacred reagents reflect the healing power and reverence the Sisterhood of Elune brings to night elf culture.
Relara’s draughts, poultices, and botanical tinctures reflect the place of herbal lore in Kaldorei medicine.
